Located north of the Grand River in Howell, Michigan, our Great Lakes Family Dental practice has been providing dental treatment to the community for over 35 years. Our staff strives to build relationships and give each patient the individual attention they deserve. Patients chose our practice for our ability to ease fearful patients and our expertise in all aspects of dentistry, including nitrous oxide sedation, and appliances for sleep apnea. Our clean and professional office has a warm feeling that will make you feel right at home.

Our dentists and dental specialists provide a full range of dental services in a comfortable welcoming setting. Preventive care such as digital x-rays and cleanings and more advanced services like braces and root canals are available in-house with no need for a referral.

Our Great Lakes Family Dental Howell dentists take pride in providing comprehensive dental services. By staying on top of the latest advances in dental care with continuing education and training, patients can feel confident in the high-quality care they receive. Building long-standing, trusting relationships with patients is a key part of overall care.

Great Lakes Family Dental Howell and all of our Great Lakes Family Dental offices are safely seeing patients with all guidelines in place.

Great Lakes Family Dental Howell sees emergency dental cases the same day as it can be acutely painful and discomforting for the patient. Great Lakes Family Dental Howell provides emergency care that can help alleviate your pain and discomfort and help prevent permanent damage or bone loss.
